en.backup_subtitle: Your 12-word recovery phrase is the only way to restore this REGTEST wallet on a new device.
en.backup_warning: Never share these words. They control access to your funds. This is a disposable REGTEST wallet — never use mainnet words or real funds.
en.phrase_grid_title: Write these 12 words down in order
en.written_checkbox: I have written these 12 words down in the correct order
en.verify_subtitle: Enter the requested words to confirm you saved the phrase.
en.verify_error: One or more words do not match. Check your written backup and try again.
en.verify_unavailable: Your words were not checked and nothing was recorded. This is not a wrong-word result. Enter the newly requested words within 2 minutes. If this repeats, the wallet could not verify its own WAM Core session: choose Back up later, quit, and reopen this wallet to verify. On Shared REGTEST, first check that the peer IP address is correct.
en.success_subtitle: Your recovery phrase has been confirmed. You can now use your REGTEST wallet.
en.locked_subtitle: Backup was postponed. Reopen this wallet to complete the secure backup.
en.close_to_lock: Closing without verifying will lock the wallet. You can complete backup on reopen.
en.recovery_verify_subtitle: Enter your 12 recovery words in order to verify and scan wallet history.
en.recovery_readonly_notice: Read-only recovery verification. This does not restore spending authority, import a seed into custody, or unlock signing.
en.recovery_invalid: Recovery phrase is not a valid 12-word BIP39 phrase. Check the words and try again.
en.backup_flow_kicker: Create your wallet / Backup verification · REGTEST
en.confirm_subtitle: Enter the requested words from your 12-word recovery phrase.
en.leave_backup_message: These 12 words are shown only once and will not be displayed again. If you leave now, this wallet locks and reopening it requires words from this phrase. Leave only if you have already written all 12 words down in order.

vi.backup_subtitle: Cụm 12 từ khôi phục là cách duy nhất để khôi phục ví REGTEST này trên thiết bị mới.
vi.backup_warning: Không bao giờ chia sẻ các từ này. Chúng kiểm soát quyền truy cập vào tiền của bạn. Đây là ví REGTEST dùng một lần — không bao giờ dùng từ mainnet hay tiền thật.
vi.phrase_grid_title: Viết đúng 12 từ này theo thứ tự
vi.written_checkbox: Tôi đã viết đúng 12 từ này theo đúng thứ tự
vi.verify_subtitle: Nhập các từ được yêu cầu để xác nhận bạn đã lưu cụm khôi phục.
vi.verify_error: Một hoặc nhiều từ không khớp. Kiểm tra bản sao lưu đã viết và thử lại.
vi.verify_unavailable: Các từ của bạn chưa được kiểm tra và không có gì được ghi nhận. Đây không phải lỗi sai từ. Hãy nhập các từ mới được yêu cầu trong vòng 2 phút. Nếu lỗi lặp lại, ví không xác minh được phiên WAM Core của chính nó: chọn Sao lưu sau, thoát rồi mở lại ví để xác minh. Với Shared REGTEST, hãy kiểm tra địa chỉ IP của peer trước.
vi.success_subtitle: Cụm khôi phục của bạn đã được xác nhận. Bạn có thể sử dụng ví REGTEST ngay bây giờ.
vi.locked_subtitle: Việc sao lưu đã bị hoãn. Hãy mở lại ví để hoàn tất sao lưu an toàn.
vi.close_to_lock: Đóng mà không xác minh sẽ khóa ví. Bạn có thể hoàn tất sao lưu khi mở lại.
vi.leave_backup_title: Rời đi khi chưa hoàn tất sao lưu?
vi.leave_backup_message: 12 từ này chỉ được hiển thị một lần và sẽ không hiển thị lại. Nếu rời đi lúc này, ví sẽ khóa và việc mở lại yêu cầu các từ trong cụm này. Chỉ rời đi nếu bạn đã viết đủ 12 từ theo đúng thứ tự.

errors.WALLET_NATIVE_CHECKPOINT_VERIFICATION_RE: This original wallet has a native checkpoint. Use Enable sending and explicitly approve custody verification before refreshing its history. Reservations remain protected; no wallet data should be reset.
errors.Q06_SHARED_RECONCILIATION_DENIED: Shared-chain reconciliation was refused. Native checkpoints, signed evidence and reservations are preserved. Verify the original profile, password and chain; do not remove runtime files.
errors.Q06_RECONCILIATION_NOT_NEEDED: The active custody session is healthy. Refresh the chain before requesting recovery.
errors.SHARED_CONFIRMED_PEER_REQUIRED: The configured Core peer is disconnected or not yet verified. Reconnect and verify the shared chain; signed and pending payments remain preserved.
errors.SHARED_SINGLE_COORDINATOR_REQUIRED: Only the explicitly designated Shared REGTEST coordinator may mine. This participant only receives and validates blocks.
errors.WALLET_EXECUTOR_OPERATION_STILL_PENDING: The operation is still running. Wait for completion; signing or broadcast will not be repeated automatically.
errors.WALLET_EXECUTOR_BUSY_OR_CLOSED: A wallet operation is in progress or the session is closed. Wait for completion or explicitly reopen the wallet.
errors.WALLET_MANAGED_RUNTIME_PRESERVED: Wallet keys are closed and recovery data is preserved. Authenticated recovery is required before reopening; do not remove files.
errors.WALLET_MANAGED_OPEN_DENIED: The wallet could not be authenticated or opened safely. Check the passphrase and current recovery state; existing data is preserved.
errors.WALLET_CORE_REAUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED: Explicit approval to reauthenticate the original REGTEST Core is required after wallet passphrase and custody verification. No automatic retry or external node adoption is allowed.
errors.WALLET_CORE_AUTHENTICATION_DENIED: Local Core authentication failed. Balances are hidden and sensitive operations are stopped. Verify the authorized local credentials, then explicitly reauthenticate. Wallet state and reservations are retained.
errors.WALLET_CORE_IDENTITY_DENIED: Local Core identity or private configuration changed. Balances are hidden and sensitive operations are stopped. Verify the original REGTEST node before authenticated reopening; do not reset custody.
errors.WALLET_CORE_UNAVAILABLE: The verified local Core is unavailable. Balances are hidden and sensitive operations are stopped. Check the authorized local node; no request is retried automatically.
errors.WALLET_CORE_UNVERIFIED: Core verification failed. Balances are hidden and sensitive operations are stopped. Explicitly verify the original REGTEST environment before authenticated reopening. Reservations remain protected.
errors.WALLET_INPUT_AMOUNT_INVALID: Amount not accepted. Enter 0.00000330 to 22000000 WAM, using a decimal point and at most 8 decimal places.
errors.WALLET_INPUT_FEE_INVALID: Fee not accepted. Enter 0.00000001 to 0.01000000 WAM, using a decimal point and at most 8 decimal places.
errors.WALLET_INPUT_RECIPIENT_INVALID: Recipient not accepted. Use the complete REGTEST silent-payment code (wamrtsp1…). Ordinary Core addresses, other networks and invalid checksums are not supported.
errors.WALLET_INPUT_FUNDS_UNAVAILABLE: Not enough available confirmed funds in one privacy cluster for the amount and fee. Coins still reserved, in the mempool, or waiting for confirmation stay unavailable; locks are not released.
errors.WALLET_STALE_SESSION_DENIED: Wallet session is stale. Sensitive operations are stopped and reservations retained. Use the latest anchored backup; do not reset or replace the anchor.
errors.WALLET_REVIEW_CHAIN_CHANGED: The chain changed after review. Recheck the live chain. Only an unsigned draft may be canceled; signed reservations stay locked.
errors.WALLET_REVIEW_UTXO_CHANGED: A reviewed input is no longer available. Signing or broadcast was refused. Reservations remain protected.
errors.WALLET_PAYMENT_ALREADY_PENDING: A payment review is already active. Finish that review or cancel its unsigned draft before preparing another.
errors.WALLET_SIGN_UNCERTAIN_LOCK_RETAINED: Signing did not complete safely. Input reservations are irreversible. Do not retry automatically or release the locks.
errors.WALLET_BROADCAST_UNCERTAIN_LOCK_RETAINED: Broadcast result is uncertain. The node may have accepted the transaction. Do not retry automatically; reservations remain locked.
errors.WALLET_BROADCAST_REJECTED_LOCK_RETAINED: The local node rejected the signed transaction before submission; it was not sent. Input reservations stay signed and locked. Nothing is retried or released automatically.
errors.WALLET_BROADCAST_NOT_SUBMITTED_LOCK_RETA: Pre-submission verification could not complete; the transaction was not sent by this wallet. Input reservations stay signed and locked. Nothing is retried or released automatically.
errors.WALLET_LOCK_CLEANUP_UNCERTAIN: Lock could not close every wallet resource. Keys were dropped from this session and it is stopped; local wallet data and reservations are preserved. Restart the application before reopening; do not remove files.
errors.WALLET_ROOT_LEASE_UNCERTAIN_LOCK_RETAINE: The independent custody lease was lost. Operations are stopped and reservations retained. Do not reset the witness or retry automatically.
errors.WALLET_BACKUP_STALE_OR_TAMPERED: This backup does not match the latest anchored checkpoint. Choose the current unmodified backup; do not reset the anchor.
errors.WALLET_UNLOCK_REFUSED: Could not unlock: passphrase, encrypted snapshot or custody verification failed. The wallet remains locked. Check the passphrase and latest backup; do not reset custody.
errors.WALLET_RECOVERY_REFUSED: Recovery was refused: backup authentication, freshness or custody could not be verified. The wallet remains locked; use the latest same-platform backup.
errors.WALLET_BACKUP_DIRECTORY_DENIED: Backup destination was refused. Choose a new private folder owned by this account, without links or inherited access.
errors.WALLET_LOCKED_OR_FAULTED: Wallet is locked or faulted. Balances are hidden and sensitive operations are unavailable; reservations remain protected.
errors.WALLET_SYNC_UNVERIFIED: Live REGTEST synchronization could not be verified. Balances are hidden. Verify the local node and use Sync again; do not reset custody.
errors.WALLET_OPERATION_DENIED_STATE_RETAINED: Operation could not complete safely. Wallet state and reservations are retained. Verify the live chain and latest checkpoint; do not reset custody.
errors.FEE_QUOTE_STALE: The network fee changed after this review. Nothing was signed and the fee was not changed. Cancel the unsigned draft and prepare the payment again.
errors.FEE_STRUCTURE_UNSTABLE: The fee for this payment could not be settled. Nothing was saved or signed. Unsigned drafts from this attempt were released.
errors.FEE_BELOW_NETWORK_FLOOR: The fee is below the network minimum. Nothing was saved or signed.
errors.FEE_ABSOLUTE_LIMIT: The fee exceeds 0.01 WAM. Nothing was saved or signed.
errors.FEE_EXCEEDS_AMOUNT: The fee is larger than the payment amount. Nothing was saved or signed.
errors.FEE_EXPLICIT_PREPARE_DENIED: A manually chosen fee is not accepted. Nothing was prepared or signed.
errors.FEE_DISPROPORTIONATE: The fee is too large for this payment amount. Nothing was saved or signed.
errors.FEE_POLICY_UNVERIFIED: The network fee could not be verified. Nothing was prepared or signed.
